## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and how this change addresses it. Link related issues.

## Validation

List the exact checks run and their results. Explain checks that could not run.
For hardware behavior, distinguish physical device testing from synthetic fixtures
and identify the tested model and platform without unique identifiers.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe any changes to commands, IPC, saved settings, platform requirements or
installation. Link updated documentation and the changelog entry when applicable.
If there are no compatibility changes, say so.
